topics.titleEn: Move to Usage-Based Pricing Without Churn
topics.angle: how-to|Migrate from seats to hybrid usage-based pricing while keeping existing customers happy.
topics.brief: Sections: why AI products break per-seat pricing; hybrid models (platform fee + metered usage/credits); choosing a value metric; grandfathering and communication; the guardrails buyers demand (caps, alerts, prepaid credits); metering and billing infra. Verify: 2026 shift to hybrid/usage-based billing; buyer demand for caps/alerts; ~25% faster growth for frequent repricers. Sources: usage-based-pricing trend reports; billing-platform guides. Distinct from 'SaaS pricing mistakes' and 'free trial vs freemium' by being a migration how-to.

topics.titleEn: What Seed Investors Want From AI Startups
topics.angle: deep-dive|What actually gets an AI startup funded in 2026 beyond a demo and a wrapper.
topics.brief: Sections: the 'wrapper' skepticism and what counts as a moat (proprietary data, distribution, workflow depth); metrics investors probe (retention, gross margin after inference costs, usage growth); defensibility vs model commoditization; what to show at seed. Verify: 2026 investor concerns on AI margins and moats; wrapper-moat debate. Sources: VC essays (a16z/YC); seed-benchmark reports. Contrarian: a slick demo hurts if margins and retention are thin. Distinct from 'bootstrap vs VC' and 'off-deck signals' posts.
